run_scenarios_by_id: run agent simulation scenarios from the registry by specifying their scenario IDs via the CLI
run_scenarios_by_json_file: run agent simulation scenarios by providing JSON scenario definition files via the CLI
run_scenarios_by_hf_url: run agent simulation scenarios by providing HuggingFace dataset URLs in hf:// format via the CLI
validate_main_scenario_sources: validate that exactly one scenario source is specified among scenario ID, JSON file, or HuggingFace URL
list_available_scenarios: list all registered agent simulation scenarios and print their keys to stdout via the CLI
